GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 6th 4 Lengths 800m 6th 5 Lengths home turn Hooked Out 3 Wide 6th widest runner Straight ran on final 200m # back/ran on/ready
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After passing the 100m had to be directed outto avoid the heels of another runner which shifted ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths , Settled touch Worse than midfield rails 6 Lengths 800m, was hampered at 500m when horses lost rider and lost momentum, stayed back inside but only battled, cross over noseband off first time # battled rails
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 500m was hampered when tightened for room by the fallen runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down 5th 4 Lengths 800m 4th 5 Lengths home turn Hard Ridden 4th fence weakened final 100m # every ch/tired late
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6 lengths. well back turn. held up late # Not Sighted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider explained app 100m was weary of the runners in advance of him weakening and had he continued to ride mount along would have improved onto heels, added whilst he acknowledged a run was present to the inside was of the view runners may shift ground if he improved into it. Rider reminded to ride mounts out when it is reasonable and permissible to do so

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Clear last 11 Lengths 800m, still out the back angling widest from the corner, he was very green in Straight and wanted to lay in proving a handful for rider but when he knuckled down late he flew to grab and eye-catching placing # powered home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping away. steadied near the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly . Niggled to recover & raced keenly Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead) early . Back 2 Lengths midrace & pushed to chase @ 600m. Struggling Six Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Weakened 8W in straight. # Always struggling.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: began fine. Settled Down Clear 4th 5 Lengths @ 750m. fanned wider into Straight all Clear . wound up , Took Lead @ 50m # bit too good here

Shade slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (3L from lead). Stayed same midrace & pushed to quicken @ 450m. Pushed along inside (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & worked home fairly in last 200m. # Sound for further.

Jumped awkwardly missing start 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , raced ungenerously and Drifted Back to 9 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted wider Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewarsds: Raced ungenerously early/middle stages.] # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Overraced during the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Couldn't keep up midrace & no improvement from home turn. Vetted clear. # Not competitive.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding which tailed off revealed no abnormalities.
